meta.title: How Student Loan Interest Starts Charging Interest
meta.hook: Student loan interest can become part of the balance that future interest is calculated on.
meta.description: Interest capitalization occurs when unpaid interest is added to a student loan's principal. Future interest then accrues on the larger principal balance, increasing total cost. The timing and rules depend on loan type and repayment status. Educational content only, not personalized financial advice.

scenes.narration: Student loan interest can become part of the balance that future interest is calculated on. That is capitalization.

visual.visual_intent: A student-loan statement with principal and interest separated
visual.decision_reason: Federal Student Aid servicer guidance defines capitalization

scenes.narration: Interest may keep accruing during certain periods when required payments are paused, depending on the loan type and status.

visual.visual_intent: A calendar beside a pause symbol and accumulating coins
visual.decision_reason: Capitalization timing varies by loan type and status

scenes.narration: When a capitalization event occurs, unpaid interest is added to principal. The official balance gets larger.

visual.visual_intent: Two labeled amounts merging into one larger balance
visual.decision_reason: Official definition: unpaid interest is added to principal

scenes.narration: After that, the daily interest calculation uses the new, higher principal, increasing the loan's total cost.

visual.visual_intent: A calculator showing interest on a larger balance
visual.decision_reason: Official guidance says future interest accrues on the larger balance

scenes.narration: Federal rules limit when capitalization can happen, so it is not correct to assume every pause triggers it.

visual.visual_intent: Official-looking loan terms with event dates highlighted
visual.decision_reason: Caveat reflects current federal capitalization rules

scenes.narration: The key is to separate accrued interest from principal and check exactly when your loan terms combine them.

visual.visual_intent: An account dashboard separating principal and accrued interest
visual.decision_reason: Practical explanation tied to the verified mechanism
